detail.body:
Part of #8814, following @delock's suggestion in #8791 and the review discussion on where the helper should live.

## Change
- Add `deepspeed/comm/pg_utils.py` with `is_parallel(group)`: `group` is not `None` and spans more than one rank.
  - `comm.py` keeps the plain collectives, where `group=None` means the world group. In `pg_utils`, `group=None` means the parallel dimension is absent.
  - `pg_utils` is **not** star-exported from `deepspeed.comm`; callers write `from deepspeed.comm import pg_utils`, so the two meanings of `None` stay apart.
  - It is a predicate rather than a per-collective wrapper (an earlier revision had `all_reduce_if_parallel`), so one helper guards every primitive: sync or async all-reduce, all-gather, inference all-reduce, ...:
    ```python
    if pg_utils.is_parallel(group):
        dist.all_reduce(tensor, group=group)
    ```
- Replace the hand-written `group is not None and dist.get_world_size(group) > 1` guards, and variants that only check `None`:

| Area | Sites |
|---|---|
| sequence | `vocab_parallel_ops.py` (5; local `_tp_active`/`_all_reduce` removed), `cross_entropy.py` (4, `_global_sp_sum`, empty-shard check) |
| MoE | `sharded_moe.py` capacity MAX reductions (3) |
| inference v1 | `ds_mlp.py`, `triton/mlp.py`, `ds_attention.py`, `triton/attention.py`, `moe_inference.py` (async all-reduce, expert-MP all-gather and split) |
| ZeRO | `stage_1_and_2.py` / `stage3.py` `_model_parallel_all_reduce`, `stage3.py` AutoEP norm reductions (3) |
| AutoTP | `module_inject/layers.py`: `RowParallel` forward, `ScatterToTensorParallelRegion` / `ColumnParallel` backward, `LmHeadLinearAllreduce` forward; `TensorParallel_Layer` caches `is_tp_parallel = is_parallel(mp_group)` once at construction, used by the 6 `mp_group is None or tp_world_size == 1` guards in `LinearAllreduce` / `LinearLayer` / `SubParam*` / fused-QKV layers (no per-call cost) |
| other | `runtime/utils.py` MoE EP norm reductions (2) |

Behavior is unchanged. Sites that only checked `None` now also skip single-rank groups, where every guarded collective is a no-op.

Not migrated:
- Guards on a separately supplied size (`len(partition_sizes)`, a `tp_world_size` argument) in gather helpers: the size is not derived from a group.
- Sites where `None` means the world group: `kv_cache` warm-up, `moe_inference._alltoall`.
- AutoEP folding correction: its guard covers more than a collective.
- Engine/ZeRO DP buckets.

## Tests
- `tests/unit/comm/test_dist.py`: `pg_utils` contract on 4 ranks.
  - 2-rank and world groups are parallel; `None` and single-rank groups are not.
  - `group=None` works without a process group.
  - `is_parallel` is not exported as `deepspeed.comm.is_parallel`.
- `tests/unit/module_inject/test_tp_autograd_reduce.py`, with 2-rank, single-rank and `None` groups:
  - `RowParallel` forward.
  - `ColumnParallel` / `ScatterToTensorParallelRegion` backward.
  - `LmHeadLinearAllreduce` output matches the unsharded linear.
- `tests/unit/runtime/test_runtime_utils.py::TestGlobalNormMoEGroup`: expert-group 2-norm and inf-norm with the same three group kinds.
- Mutation check: making `is_parallel(None)` return True (a world reduction) fails the `None` cases of the new tests.
- Regression, 108 passed and 4 skipped: the new tests plus
  - `test_runtime_utils.py`
  - `test_moe.py::TestMoESingleton`
  - `test_vocab_parallel_ops.py`
  - `test_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy.py`
  - `test_liger_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy.py`
  - `test_invalid_grad_norm.py`

Run on 8× Intel Arc Pro B70 (XPU, XCCL), torch 2.14.0.dev20260804+xpu.



## Contribution checklist

**Related work.** This is part of RFC #8814. A search for `is_parallel`, `all_reduce_if_parallel` and "optional parallel group" found no other PR that adds an optional-group predicate.

**Commands and results.** Hardware and software: 8× Intel Arc Pro B70 (XPU, XCCL), Level Zero driver 1.15.39122 (compute runtime 26.27.39122.11), torch 2.14.0.dev20260804+xpu.
```
pytest -p no:randomly tests/unit/comm/test_dist.py tests/unit/module_inject/test_tp_autograd_reduce.py \
  tests/unit/runtime/test_runtime_utils.py tests/unit/v1/moe/test_moe.py::TestMoESingleton \
  tests/unit/v1/sequence_parallelism/test_vocab_parallel_ops.py \
  tests/unit/v1/sequence_parallelism/test_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy.py \
  tests/unit/v1/sequence_parallelism/test_liger_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy.py \
  tests/unit/v1/zero/test_invalid_grad_norm.py
```
- The command above: 108 passed, 4 skipped.
- `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_unit.py`: 192 passed. This covers the ZeRO-3 AutoEP norm paths. Its fake EP group now mocks `dist.get_world_size`, because `is_parallel` queries the group size.

**Numerics, performance, memory.** Nothing changes. Every site keeps the same collective; sites that only checked for `None` now also skip single-rank groups, where the collective is a no-op.

**Compatibility matrix.**

| | Validated | Not validated on device |
|---|---|---|
| AutoTP | `RowParallel` / `ColumnParallel` / `ScatterToTensorParallelRegion` / `LmHeadLinearAllreduce` with 2-rank, single-rank and `None` groups | |
| ZeRO | stage 1/2/3 `_model_parallel_all_reduce`; stage-3 AutoEP norm paths in unit tests | Offload |
| MoE | EP norm reductions; `TestMoESingleton` | |
| Sequence | Vocab-parallel ops and cross entropy with TP=2 | |
| Inference v1 | | `ds_mlp`, `ds_attention`, `triton/*`, `moe_inference`: mechanical guard replacement only |
| Accelerator | XPU | CUDA, HPU |

**AI assistance.** This PR was developed with AI assistance (GitHub Copilot CLI). I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests above.

detail.title: Add deepspeed.comm.pg_utils.is_parallel for optional parallel groups

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+# DeepSpeed Team
+"""
+Helpers for optional parallel process groups.
+
+Code for an optional parallel dimension (tensor, sequence, expert, ...) commonly receives ``group=None``
+when that dimension is not used. Here ``None`` therefore means *no parallelism*, unlike the collectives in
+``deepspeed.comm`` where ``group=None`` means the world group. To keep the two meanings apart, this module
+is not re-exported from ``deepspeed.comm``; import it as ``from deepspeed.comm import pg_utils``.
+"""
+
+import deepspeed.comm as dist
+
+
+def is_parallel(group):
+    """
+    Return whether ``group`` spans more than one rank, i.e. whether a collective over it has any effect.
+
+    ``None`` marks an absent parallel dimension and returns ``False`` without touching the process group,
+    so it also works before ``torch.distributed`` is initialized. It never means the world group; pass
+    the world group explicitly to test it.
+
+    Guard any collective over an optional group with it::
+
+        if pg_utils.is_parallel(group):
+            dist.all_reduce(tensor, group=group)
+    """
+    return group is not None and dist.get_world_size(group) > 1

+def _tp_group(kind):
+    """Return this rank's group: a real 2-rank group, a single-rank group, or None (no TP)."""
+    if kind == "none":
+        return None
+    if kind == "pair":
+        return dist.new_group([0, 1])
+    singles = [dist.new_group([r]) for r in range(dist.get_world_size())]
+    return singles[dist.get_rank()]
+
+
+class TestTensorParallelBackwardReduce(DistributedTest):
+    world_size = 2
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["pair", "single", "none"])
+    def test_row_parallel_forward(self, kind):
+        group = _tp_group(kind)
+        rank = dist.get_rank()
+        x = torch.full((3, ), rank + 1.0, device=get_accelerator().device_name())
+
+        out = RowParallel.apply(group, x, False)
+
+        # Only a multi-rank TP group sums the partial outputs (1 + 2); None must not reduce over the world.
+        expected = 3.0 if kind == "pair" else rank + 1.0
+        assert torch.all(out == expected)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["pair", "single", "none"])
+    def test_column_parallel(self, kind):
+        group = _tp_group(kind)
+        rank = dist.get_rank()
+        x = torch.ones(3, device=get_accelerator().device_name(), requires_grad=True)
+
+        (ColumnParallel.apply(group, x) * (rank + 1)).sum().backward()
+
+        # Only a multi-rank TP group sums the replicated input gradient (1 + 2); without TP each
+        # rank keeps its own, and None must not fall back to reducing over the world group.
+        expected = 3.0 if kind == "pair" else rank + 1.0
+        assert torch.all(x.grad == expected)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["pair", "single", "none"])
+    def test_scatter_to_tensor_parallel_region(self, kind):
+        group = _tp_group(kind)
+        rank = dist.get_rank()
+        tp_size = 2 if kind == "pair" else 1
+        partition_sizes = [4 // tp_size] * tp_size
+        tp_index = rank if kind == "pair" else 0
+        x = torch.ones(4, device=get_accelerator().device_name(), requires_grad=True)
+
+        out = ScatterToTensorParallelRegion.apply(group, x, partition_sizes, tp_index)
+        (out * (rank + 1)).sum().backward()
+
+        # With TP each rank owns one slice, so the full gradient is the concatenation of every rank's
+        # slice gradient; without TP the rank owns the whole input.
+        if kind == "pair":
+            expected = torch.tensor([1.0, 1.0, 2.0, 2.0])
+        else:
+            expected = torch.full((4, ), rank + 1.0)
+        assert torch.equal(x.grad.cpu(), expected)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["pair", "single", "none"])
+    def test_lm_head_linear_allreduce(self, kind):

+        device = get_accelerator().device_name()
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        linear = torch.nn.Linear(4, 3, bias=False).to(device)

+        expected = linear(x).detach()
+

+        # its input shards, and without TP the single rank holds the full weight and must not reduce again.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip process groups that exclude this rank**

When a caller passes a process group that excludes the current rank, `get_world_size(group)` returns `-1` per this module's contract, so this equality check falls through even though there is no local work. This regresses the replaced `> 1` guards and is not harmless on the custom CCL backend: `CCLBackend.get_all_ranks_from_group` derives an empty rank list and calls `_new_group`, which indexes `ranks[0]`; reduce only when the reported size is greater than one so non-members skip the collective.

`all_reduce_if_parallel` is exported through `deepspeed.comm` and gives `group=None` semantics that intentionally differ from `all_reduce`, but this commit adds no entry under `docs/code-docs/source`, and a repository-wide `rg` finds no documentation of the name outside source and tests.
